name: Shopping
overview: Scripture warns believers against placing their trust and affection in earthly possessions, emphasizing that life’s value is not found in material abundance but in faithfulness to God. Jesus teaches that one cannot serve both God and wealth, urging believers to seek treasures in heaven rather than on earth where decay and theft occur. Contentment and generosity are encouraged, with faithfulness in worldly resources seen as a test for receiving true, eternal riches. Ultimately, God’s promise to never forsake His people undergirds a life free from covetousness and anchored in trust.
